title: HateModerate: Testing Hate Speech Detectors against Content Moderation Policies

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the hate speech probability assigned by fine-tuned models to synthetic template sentences containing racial or ethnic identity terms (e.g., 'Asians', 'Middle Eastern people') to check for disproportionate false positive rates.
Measuring the models' hate speech predictions on synthetic examples featuring sexual orientation identity terms (e.g., 'Homos') combined with adjectives to identify abnormal toxicity associations.
Testing the models on non-hateful suites from the HateCheck dataset that specifically target women (e.g., non-hateful homonyms of slurs, reclaimed slurs) to measure false positive failure rates.
